## setting
**254 run(s)** — rule `krem-kern-setting` — 10.1038/nature25966  
*Methods, Tissue collection and RNA extraction*

> Seven developing kernels were collected from three plants at 350-growing-degree days after self-pollination ... from 25 August 2014 to 19 September 2014, from plants grown in field M1 (Lima silt loam soil) at the Cornell Musgrave Research Farm. Using these same plots, mature leaves were collected during the day (11:00-13:00) and during the night (23:00-01:00) in two batches, on 8 August 2014 and 26 August 2014.

## sampling_selection
**740 run(s)** — rule `unselected-PRJNA383416` — (multiple)  
*cross-study determination over the studies' own design statements*

> Determination, not a quotation: for each study below the sampling criterion is stated in the named evidence row, and in none of them is it the presence of disease. PRJNA306542 drought vs well-watered genotype screen (ev-luo2020-design, ev-ma2016-site). PRJNA609211 tillering/maturity stages and an ncRNA arm at the same facility (ev-xia2020t-site, ev-xia2020m-site). PRJNA746402 a maize MAGIC field trial sampled by genotype (ev-cai21b-site). PRJNA383416 a maize diversity panel sampled by genotype and tissue across three settings (ev-krem-field). PRJNA674915/PRJNA915033 grapevine sampled by rootstock, irrigation and phenological stage (ev-har21e-design). PRJNA726716 rice sampled by light and temperature transfer condition (ev-hashida-field). PRJNA510920 rice sampled by nitrogen and water dose at a fixed 49 DAS (ev-swift2019-f16). PRJDB7234 a paddy sampled bihourly for 24 h on sixteen fixed dates (ev-kashima-site). Sampling was therefore driven by genotype, imposed treatment, phenological stage or clock time. Any pathogen present is incidental to why the sample exists, which is the condition the cryptic co-infection hypothesis requires. Contrast disease-selected cohorts, where a plant was sampled BECAUSE it was symptomatic: those are a strong co-infection test set and an unusable prevalence denominator.

## tissue
**210 run(s)** — rule `krem-tissue-lmad` — 10.1038/nature25966  
*Methods, 'Tissue collection', field plots*

> 'Seven developing kernels were collected from three plants at 350-growing-degree days after self-pollination and immediately frozen in liquid nitrogen. Based on pollination date, kernels were harvested between 11:00 and 13:00 from 25 August 2014 to 19 September 2014, from plants grown in field M1 (Lima silt loam soil) at the Cornell Musgrave Research Farm. Seven immature kernels were collected and combined from three plants per genotype. End plants from each plot were avoided whenever possible. Using these same plots, mature leaves were collected during the day (11:00-13:00) and during the night (23:00-01:00) in two batches, on 8 August 2014 and 26 August 2014. ... Leaf sections from three plants per plot were collected into liquid nitrogen from a 1-cm section to one side of the midrib.'
